definitions.explanation: Managed or operated by the government, as opposed to private enterprise.

examples.japanese: {官営|かんえい}の{工場|こうじょう}で{働|はたら}いた。
examples.english: I worked at a government-run factory.

examples.japanese: {明治|めいじ}{時代|じだい}には{多|おお}くの{官営|かんえい}{事業|じぎょう}が{設立|せつりつ}された。
examples.english: Many state-run enterprises were established during the Meiji era.

examples.japanese: {富岡|とみおか}{製糸場|せいしじょう}は{明治|めいじ}{政府|せいふ}が{設立|せつりつ}した{官営|かんえい}{模範|もはん}{工場|こうじょう}として{知|し}られている。
examples.english: The Tomioka Silk Mill is known as a government-operated model factory established by the Meiji government.

notes:
A compound of {官|かん} (government, official) and {営|えい} (to operate, manage). Describes enterprises, facilities, or services operated directly by the government.

Historically significant in Japanese history: during the Meiji era, the government established numerous {官営|かんえい} factories and enterprises to modernize Japan's industry. Many were later sold off to private companies in a policy known as {払|はら}い{下|さ}げ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {官営|かんえい}{工場|こうじょう}: government-operated factory
- {官営|かんえい}{事業|じぎょう}: state-run enterprise
- {官営|かんえい}{鉄道|てつどう}: government-operated railway
- {官営|かんえい}{模範|もはん}{工場|こうじょう}: government model factory

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {国営|こくえい}: nationally operated — specifically run by the national government
- {公営|こうえい}: publicly operated — run by any public entity including local governments
- {民営|みんえい}: privately operated — the opposite of government-run
